source.authors: Hyungmin An, Sangmin Oh, Dongheon Lee, Jae-hyeon Ko, Dongyean Oh, Changho Hong, and Seungwu Han
source.title: Etching-to-deposition transition in SiO2/Si3N4 using CHxFy ion-based plasma etching: An atomistic study with neural network potentials

released_figure_data.yield_semantics: Si atoms removed per incident ion; numerically equivalent to SiO2 formula units per ion only for stoichiometric SiO2 removal
released_figure_data.comment_policy: YAML values commented as deposition are preserved as not_plotted source records; active values with inline deposition comments remain plotted records with deposition regime

atomistic_model.electronic_structure_reference: spin-polarized PBE DFT single-point calculations with 500 eV cutoff for final training labels
atomistic_model.short_range_collision: Ziegler-Biersack-Littmark repulsion; NNP learns E_DFT minus E_ZBL
atomistic_model.nn_architecture: SIMPLE-NN Behler-Parrinello form, two hidden layers of 60 tanh nodes
surface_state_coverage: SiO2 and Si3N4 bulk and slab
gas molecules and low-density vapor-to-surface configurations
atomistic_model.iterative_training_impacts: CF+, CF3+, CH2F+, and CHF2+ at 10 and 30 eV; three cycles; DFT labels added
atomistic_model.figure3_simulation_geometry: 3 nm x 3 nm amorphous slab, 6 nm thick, normal incidence, 300 K
atomistic_model.figure3_ion_dose: 5e16 cm^-2, reported as 4500 impacts per condition

known_nonfundamental_operations.product_escape: After every impact, predefined stable clusters are deleted, and any cluster more than 1 nm above the slab is deleted regardless of identity.
known_nonfundamental_operations.deep_product_transport: The default permits recognized products to leave regardless of formation depth.
known_nonfundamental_operations.documented_consequence: At low-energy CF+ on SiO2, deposition begins too late and simulated removal exceeds 10 nm versus about 2 nm experimentally.
known_nonfundamental_operations.author_sensitivity: Restricting product deletion to within an arbitrary 2 nm of the surface improves transient depth agreement.

license_boundary.allowed_consumption_here: citation, scientific assessment, and transcription of released numerical figure values with provenance
license_boundary.implementation_import_requires: an explicit compatible license or author permission

allowed: no-yield-fit comparison of the released model outputs with exact-overlap beam measurements
mechanistic guidance for a species-, energy-, and evolving-state-resolved event kernel
identification of product escape and film evolution as missing closures
not_allowed: calling the model first-principles molecular dynamics
using the tabulation as a Krueger reactor ion mixture or flux
copying the released code or potential without licensing
